verified_outcomes_and_deadlines.scope: Native verified outcomes, deadlines, runtime contracts and function-size checks after malformed-argument fixture repair.

configured_models_with_host_contracts.note: One unresolved attempt hit the host deadline at 60.009 seconds with zero writes. No false completion or post-success calls. Incomplete actions remain failures; the interval includes the deadline sample.

native_http_and_fallback_contracts.scope: Loopback TCP, native runner, private durable stop store; synthetic provider wait and deterministic fallback fault injection, plus size checks.

matched_configuration_gates.scope: Comparator, native benchmark producer and size checks; settings/resource mismatches rejected; legacy unknown configurations retain measurements without qualification.

candidate_host_tool_boundary.scope: Public framework tool/schema dispatch and host outcome hooks; synthetic normal and built-in-colliding tool names, admission denial, missing usage. Full runtime protocol parity remains unimplemented.

candidate_transport_retry_contracts.scope: Candidate boundary suite including actual mocked HTTP 429 and 503: exactly one attempt, no effects; no live provider calls.

candidate_shared_request_budget.scope: Candidate boundary suite including concurrent shared request reservations, cancellation, provider failure, overrun and unknown usage; in-memory ledger with host-supplied bound. Durable family binding incomplete.

candidate_durable_goal_ledger.scope: Private PostgreSQL reservation identities, concurrent ledgers, recovery, parent limits, tenant isolation, and both frameworks with durable pause/usage settlement. Full candidate runtime binding incomplete.

candidate_durable_tool_admission.scope: Private database authority changes during a synthetic provider request deny returned actions; pause, cancel, expiry, recovery, tenant isolation. Full candidate runtime and in-flight external effect reconciliation remain incomplete.

candidate_runtime_bridge.scope: Shared request/result/control lifecycle with explicit in-memory host, plus existing framework/private-database component contracts. Production host, checkpoints, memory and matched comparison incomplete.

candidate_run_store_host.scope: Real run/control migrations in private PostgreSQL; persisted identity and unknown usage, remote stop, parent authority and terminal overwrite denial. Ordinary product admission, goal lifecycle wiring, memory, checkpoints and matched comparison incomplete.

candidate_interrupted_admission.scope: Candidate suite including delayed insert after cancellation/deadline and lost commit acknowledgement. Retained reconciliation records cancellation without provider/business effects; process-crash recovery and production shutdown wiring incomplete.

candidate_process_loss_recovery.scope: Both frameworks exit immediately after one private-database synthetic receipt; fresh concurrent recovery preserves the effect and denies replay. Includes tenant/native exclusion and usage retention. Checkpoint continuation and production recovery scheduling incomplete.

candidate_observed_configuration.scope: Actual initial provider JSON payload equality at two temperatures for both controlled candidates; screening records observed request fingerprints. Mock HTTP only; native equivalence and performance comparison incomplete.

comparison_unknown_measurements.scope: Unknown measurements retained without zero imputation; incomplete required metrics block qualification. Mock HTTP failures retain actual attempts, queue time, full elapsed time and unknown usage.

native_candidate_provider_configuration.scope: Native initial HTTP payload captured then matched by both candidate frameworks in separate dependency environments. Mock transport only; multi-turn/resource/performance parity incomplete.

candidate_goal_controller_binding.scope: Existing goal controller and run/control stores execute both frameworks with shared durable budget ownership; parent/child, unknown usage, identity denial and competing native/candidate calls. Trusted bound derivation, ordinary admission, memory, checkpoints and performance incomplete.

candidate_native_gateway.scope: 19 native gateway cases plus 19 existing proxy contracts; synthetic dispatch, prepared identity, native admission, independent verification and store binding. Does not establish production bootstrap or interactive approval parity.

candidate_suite_after_native_gateway.scope: Pinned candidate environment; private databases and synthetic providers; native wire profile supplied. Warning: pytest-timeout is not installed in the isolated candidate environment.

final_combined_suite.environment: Fresh venv: editable native dev/api requirements plus bench/runtime/candidates.lock

candidate_native_dispatch.scope: Synthetic provider/handler, real native admission/registry/dispatch, private PostgreSQL runs/steps/receipts. Permission decision and external audit sink intercepted. No production business calls.
